Dialogue_Text: "The devils fell. It must have been the one they were sent to kill; sent by another devil for... whatever reason. What's important is that their target is dead. Now, the heroes shall hope that the devil will grant them the knowledge they needed."
Who shall be given that book's gift?
The lore shall be the prize. And it should be ours too, by proxy.
I never really cared about the deal. I was there to test myself. And while that devil has not surprised me much, those women and their bows: avoiding them was quite a task.
Of course. But who shall be the very person to learn it?
